notes.title: mocopi VR 2.5.0 released
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291918/58d26e4103eb411d778e1ff996e1d02da919bd1f.png"][/img][/p][h3]mocopi VR version 2.5.0 is released![/h3][p]
[/p][list][*][p] Enabled assigning HEAD sensor to chest
[/p][/*][*][p] Improved motion stuttering
[/p][/*][*][p] Added overlay display during reset pose
[/p][/*][/list][p]
Now you can assign a HEAD sensor to your chest. To use this new “+ CHEST sensor mode”, a mocopi Sensor data receiver is required.

Check here for more information about Sensor data receiver:
https://electronics.sony.com/more/mocopi/c/all-mocopi[/p]

notes.title: mocopi VR 2.0.0 released
notes.notes:
[h3]mocopi VR version 2.0.0 is released![/h3]

[list]
[*] Support for 5-point connection with mocopi sensor data receiver
[/list]

Now you can connect mocopi directly to your PC without a smartphone by using one mocopi Sensor Data Receiver.

Check here for more information about sensor data receiver:
https://electronics.sony.com/more/mocopi/c/all-mocopi
